mini_task_spec:
In the `test-repo/packages/` directory there are nine subdirectories, each containing a `package.json`. Read **all nine** `package.json` files — from `test-repo/packages/common/package.json`, `test-repo/packages/core/package.json`, `test-repo/packages/microservices/package.json`, `test-repo/packages/platform-express/package.json`, `test-repo/packages/platform-fastify/package.json`, `test-repo/packages/platform-socket.io/package.json`, `test-repo/packages/platform-ws/package.json`, `test-repo/packages/testing/package.json`, and `test-repo/packages/websockets/package.json` — and for each one report the `name` field and the count of entries in the `peerDependencies` object. Output one line per package, sorted alphabetically by subdirectory name, in this exact format:

```
<subdirectory-name>: <npm-package-name> (<N> peerDependencies)
```

Example line: `common: @nestjs/common (4 peerDependencies)`
